code_delta.reason: The existing snapshot probe can spend a long time hashing large safetensors shards while config.json or model.safetensors.index.json is changed or newly published. Without a bounded metadata post-read check, it could expose a seemingly complete but inconsistent mixed-time observation.
changes: Re-read and compare SHA-256 of bounded config.json after all shard SHA-256 and total_size checks.
For indexed snapshots, re-read and compare SHA-256 of original model.safetensors.index.json.
For originally unindexed snapshots, reject an index first published during the weight hash.
On any detected mismatch, return HOLD and clear weight_files/tensor_headers/observed fingerprint; preserve existing full-shard SHA and size logic.
code_delta.caution: A second read mitigates ordinary mutation/replacement; it is NOT an atomic multi-file filesystem lock or protection against an adversary changing files back between reads.
